solutions.title: Seen set
solutions.strategy: Store all positive values and scan upward from one until a missing value appears.

timeComplexity.explanation: Building the set and scanning candidate values are linear in the array length.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The set can store every input value.

solutions.title: Index placement
solutions.strategy: Repeatedly swap each value v into index v - 1 when v is within the useful range.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every successful swap places at least one value into its final slot.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The input array is rearranged in place by the driver-isolated call.
